title: reference-http-identity-lifecycle acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.user.create, identity.user.get, identity.user.update-admin, identity.user.suspend, identity.user.restore, identity.admin.user-delete; exact inputs: tenant_id, user_fields, user_id, expected_version, idempotency_key; initial state: tenant has no user with the canonical identifiers

stimulus.const: Run identity.user.create then identity.user.get then identity.user.update-admin then identity.user.suspend then identity.user.restore then identity.admin.user-delete for success, failure, denial, replay, concurrency, cleanup cases using tenant_id, user_fields, user_id, expected_version, idempotency_key and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: HTTP create, get, update, suspend, restore, and delete expose exact versions and lifecycle state without cross-tenant access; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none; required artifact fields: user_id, created_version, final_version, final_state, lifecycle_event_digest

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: HTTP create, get, update, suspend, restore, and delete expose exact versions and lifecycle state without cross-tenant access; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none; required artifact fields: user_id, created_version, final_version, final_state, lifecycle_event_digest

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/reference-http-identity-lifecycle.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/reference-http-identity-lifecycle.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest
